title: The Python package is now coastal-arena
author: Shockwave (Engine Lead)
body: The Python package that turns Tank Arena and Racing into training environments has a new name: coastal-arena, imported as coastal_arena. Nothing else about it changes: same optional add-ons, same API, same Rust underneath.
We renamed it so that "Saltmarsh" only ever means our Python robotics library. Matches played from Python still replay exactly in Rust, and the engine itself is untouched.
next: The CI workflow switches to the new test settings, and Saltmarsh gets a matching rename.
